newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Yeltsin meets Russian PM Chernomyrdin in hospital.
newsitem.headline: Yeltsin meets Russian PM Chernomyrdin in hospital.

text.p: President Boris Yeltsin met Prime Minister Viktor Chernomyrdin for talks on Tuesday in Moscow's Central Clinical Hospital, where the 65-year-old Russian leader is preparing for a planned heart operation.
The presidential press service, which announced the meeting, gave no details.
Yeltsin issued a decree last week saying Chernomyrdin would stand in for him while he has surgery and he has already transferred some of his duties to the prime minister.
Yastrzhembsky said the meeting would take place at Moscow's Central Clinical Hospital, where Yeltsin, 65, has been undergoing tests for the last 10 days.
"A summary will be made after the council and this will be made public, but let us leave to the doctors how and in what form this will be done," he said.
Asked if the operation could be cancelled, Yastrzhembsky replied: "I cannot say yes or no. I am not a doctor."
Yeltsin said earlier this month he had agreed to have an operation after doctors said the alternative was to adopt a passive way of life.
